description_good_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/README.md -- the opening lines say what the software does.
interact_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/README.md and https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md -- how to get it, file issues and contribute.
contribution_requirements_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md -- Conventional Commits, sign-off, signed commits and the repository's full check are required.
floss_license_justification: The MIT license is approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).
floss_license_osi_justification: The MIT license is approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).
documentation_interface_justification: README.md#measure-from-the-command-line documents the flags and output of scripts/measure.mjs and evals/p4.mjs. (https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/README.md)
discussion_justification: GitHub Issues: searchable, addressable by URL, open to anyone, no proprietary client required.
english_justification: All docs are in English; issues and PRs in English are expected and supported.
maintained_justification: Actively maintained; see the commit history.
repo_track_justification: Repository on GitHub, which uses git. git tracks the changes, who made them, and when.
repo_interim_justification: Commits between releases are visible in git history.
repo_distributed_justification: Repository on GitHub, which uses git. git is distributed.
version_unique_justification: Every release has a unique version, set in .claude-plugin/plugin.json and tagged m3l-output-governor--vX.Y.Z. 1.0.0 is the first, released 2026-10-20. Every commit also has a unique SHA.
version_semver_justification: Releases use Semantic Versioning. The contract that a major, minor or patch bump refers to is defined under Versioning policy in README.md.
version_tags_justification: Each release is a signed git tag named m3l-output-governor--vX.Y.Z, and the org tags ruleset stops a tag being moved or deleted. For example https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/releases/tag/m3l-output-governor--v1.0.0 .
release_notes_justification: Each release has a GitHub release page whose notes are the matching CHANGELOG.md section. For example https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/releases/tag/m3l-output-governor--v1.0.0 .
release_notes_vulns_justification: No CVE has been assigned against this project. SECURITY.md's process commits to a published advisory if one is.
report_process_justification: Bug reports go through GitHub Issues: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/issues (see also https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
report_responses_justification: No bug report from outside the organization has been opened to date, so none is unanswered. SECURITY.md commits to acknowledging a vulnerability report within 7 days.
enhancement_responses_justification: Enhancement requests are triaged the same way as bug reports.
report_archive_justification: GitHub Issues is a public, searchable archive of every report and response: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/issues
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/SECURITY.md commits to acknowledgment within 7 days, under the criterion's 14-day bar.
build_justification: Nothing to build: the repository is used as committed source files.
test_invocation_justification: The standard command for this ecosystem is documented in README.md#working-on-this-repo.
test_most_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/.github/workflows/verify.yml measures coverage over scripts/ and evals/ and gates it at 80%. It measures about 90% lines, 86% branches and 95% functions.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/.github/workflows/verify.yml runs the suite on every push and PR.
test_policy_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-requests -- new behaviour needs tests and a fix needs a regression test.
tests_are_added_justification: Recent commits (the eval fixture fix, the measure changes) add tests alongside the behaviour they cover.
tests_documented_added_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-requests and the pull request template both state the policy.
warnings_justification: CodeQL runs on every push and PR, and CI runs actionlint and zizmor on the workflows. There is no TypeScript or separate JavaScript linter.
warnings_fixed_justification: Findings from these tools fail the required `verify` or CodeQL check, so none is merged unfixed.
warnings_strict_justification: Not applicable: no compiler or linter flag to make strict; CodeQL, actionlint and zizmor fail the build on a finding.
know_secure_design_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/SECURITY.md states the scope, secrets handling and accepted risks; the maintainers also keep m3l-groundwork's docs/assurance-case.md (https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/docs/assurance-case.md), which maps the Saltzer and Schroeder principles.
know_common_errors_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/docs/assurance-case.md's CWE Top 25 table, kept by the same maintainers, names the vulnerability types and the mitigation for each.
crypto_password_storage_justification: The project stores no passwords for authenticating users.
delivery_mitm_justification: Distributed only through GitHub over HTTPS: the repository, its release tags, and the monte3l/m3l-plugins catalog, which clones the pinned tag from an https:// URL.
delivery_unsigned_justification: No hash is fetched over plain HTTP and used without a signature check.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/SECURITY.md commits to fixing a confirmed medium-or-higher vulnerability within 60 days; none is open.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: GitHub secret scanning and push protection are enabled, and .github/workflows/gitleaks.yml runs a second scan on every push and PR.
static_analysis_justification: GitHub CodeQL (default setup) analyzes every push and PR, more often than each release.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL's default query suite covers common vulnerability classes (CWE-mapped).
static_analysis_fixed_justification: CodeQL is a required check on `main`, so a confirmed finding is fixed before merge.
static_analysis_often_justification: CodeQL runs on every push and PR, not just daily.
dynamic_analysis_justification: No dynamic analysis tool is run. This criterion is only suggested.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: No memory-unsafe code: JavaScript or TypeScript on a managed runtime.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: No dynamic analysis tool is run, so there is nothing to run with assertions enabled. This criterion is only suggested.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: No dynamic analysis tool is run.
osps_ac_01_01_justification: The monte3l organization requires two-factor authentication for every member.
osps_ac_02_01_justification: The organization's default repository permission is read; write access is granted by hand.
osps_ac_03_01_justification: The `main` ruleset requires a pull request with a code-owner approval and the required checks, with an empty bypass list. Direct pushes are rejected.
osps_ac_03_02_justification: The `main` ruleset blocks deletion of the branch, with an empty bypass list.
osps_br_01_01_justification: No workflow interpolates event metadata into a script: values reach `run:` steps through `env:`. zizmor, which flags template injection, runs in CI and reports no findings.
osps_br_01_03_justification: No workflow uses `pull_request_target` or `workflow_run`. Pull-request workflows hold read-only tokens and no secrets, except the org Gitleaks license, which the Gitleaks job needs.
osps_br_03_01_justification: Every official project URL (the repository, the issue tracker and the security advisory form) is served over HTTPS by GitHub.
osps_br_03_02_justification: The only distribution channels are GitHub and the monte3l/m3l-plugins catalog, which pins this repository's release tag over an https:// URL.
osps_br_07_01_justification: GitHub secret scanning and push protection are on, and .github/workflows/gitleaks.yml scans every push and PR. Both are required checks.
osps_do_01_01_justification: The README Quickstart, How it works and the measure.mjs and p4.mjs flag tables are the user guide for the plugin and its skill.
osps_do_02_01_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md, under Reporting a bug, links to the issue form and says what a report must contain. SECURITY.md covers vulnerabilities.
osps_gv_02_01_justification: GitHub Issues is open for discussion of changes and usage problems: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/issues
osps_gv_03_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md explains the contribution process, including that pull requests are limited to collaborators.
osps_le_02_01_justification: MIT, which meets the OSI Open Source Definition.
osps_le_02_02_justification: MIT, which meets the OSI Open Source Definition, and every release is a tag of this repository.
osps_le_03_02_justification: LICENSE sits at the repository root, so it is inside every release tag and every installed copy of the plugin.
osps_qa_01_02_justification: git history on GitHub records every change, its author and its date.
osps_qa_02_01_justification: The only package-managed dependencies are the CI tools in `.github/ci-tools/`, pinned by `package-lock.json`; every GitHub Action is pinned by commit SHA.
osps_qa_04_01_justification: The project is a single repository.
osps_qa_05_01_justification: The repository holds no generated executable artifacts.
osps_qa_05_02_justification: The repository holds no binary artifacts.
osps_vm_02_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability gives the private advisory form and the 7-day acknowledgment target.
dco_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#commits -- every commit needs a Signed-off-by trailer, and the DCO sign-off check in verify.yml fails a pull request without one.
governance_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/docs/GOVERNANCE.md -- a single-maintainer model with the decision process written down.
code_of_conduct_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/.github/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, the organization default that applies to this repository. CONTRIBUTING.md#conduct links it.
access_continuity_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/docs/GOVERNANCE.md#access-continuity -- a documented solo-maintainer plan: a second organization owner, a release path no one person holds, and an emergency access kit.
documentation_security_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/README.md#how-it-works says what the plugin runs and what it never prints, and https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/docs/assurance-case.md says what a user can and cannot expect.
documentation_current_justification: The pull request template and CONTRIBUTING.md require the README and results to change with the behaviour, and scripts/doc-parity.mjs fails the docs check when a documented flag, default, field or number drifts from the code.
documentation_achievements_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/README.md shows the OpenSSF Best Practices badge for project 15707, and the Scorecard and REUSE badges.
accessibility_best_practices_justificati: No UI. The surfaces are plain-text and JSON command output, and GitHub's own pages.
internationalization_justification: No localizable end-user text. The script prints developer-facing counts and usage errors.
sites_password_security_justification: No project-controlled site stores passwords. The docs site is static.
maintenance_or_update_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/SECURITY.md#supported-versions and #scope-and-duration-of-support state what is supported and for how long.
vulnerability_report_credit_justificatio: No vulnerability report has been resolved yet. https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/SECURITY.md#credit commits to crediting the reporter.
coding_standards_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#coding-standards names .editorconfig, ES modules only, no dependency and the coverage gate.
coding_standards_enforced_justification: verify.yml runs editorconfig-checker over every tracked file the repository writes, guard-no-commonjs.mjs refuses CommonJS, and the coverage gate fails below 80%.
build_repeatable_justification: Nothing to build: the committed source is what runs.
installation_common_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/README.md#quickstart -- the two /plugin commands, the standard way to install a Claude Code plugin.
installation_standard_variables_justific: A plugin is installed by Claude Code into its own plugin directory. There is no install-location convention such as DESTDIR.
installation_development_quick_justifica: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/README.md#working-on-this-repo and https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#building-and-testing -- clone the repository and run the listed commands. There is nothing to install or build.
external_dependencies_justification: The plugin has no dependency, and the CI tools are listed in machine-readable form in .github/ci-tools/package.json and .github/deploy-tools/package.json with lockfiles. https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#dependencies.
dependency_monitoring_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/.github/workflows/dependency-review.yml fails a pull request on a high-severity vulnerability, and Dependabot (https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/.github/dependabot.yml) proposes updates to the pinned Actions and CI tools.
updateable_reused_components_justificati: The only reused components are the pinned CI tools and GitHub Actions. Lockfiles and commit SHAs pin them, and Dependabot proposes bumps.
interfaces_current_justification: The script uses Node built-ins only, and CI runs the version in .node-version (Node 24).
automated_integration_testing_justificat: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/.github/workflows/verify.yml runs the whole test suite on every push and pull request and reports one aggregated verify status.
regression_tests_added50_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-requests requires a regression test for a fix. The CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR fix in measure.mjs and the eval fixture fix each landed with a test (UNVERIFIED.md, Closed 22).
test_statement_coverage80_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/.github/workflows/verify.yml runs Node's built-in coverage over scripts/ and evals/ with an 80% line, branch and function gate. It measures about 90% lines.
test_policy_mandated_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-requests -- new behaviour needs tests, and the coverage gate fails below 80%.
crypto_credential_agility_justification: No cryptographic credential is embedded in the software.
crypto_certificate_verification_justific: No TLS or certificate code. The plugin makes no network call.
signed_releases_justification: Release tags are signed git tags. From the release after 1.0.0 each release also carries a source tarball with a Sigstore build-provenance attestation. https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/SECURITY.md#verifying-releases.
version_tags_signed_justification: Each release tag m3l-output-governor--vX.Y.Z is signed, and the org tags ruleset stops one being moved. https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/SECURITY.md#verifying-releases.
input_validation_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/scripts/measure.mjs rejects an unknown flag and a non-positive --gate with exit 2 and skips malformed lines and unreadable files, all tested in tests/measure.test.mjs. See https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/docs/assurance-case.md.
contributors_unassociated_justification: Every contributor belongs to the monte3l organization. https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/docs/GOVERNANCE.md#gold-level-criteria-this-project-does-not-meet. Gold only.
copyright_per_file_justification: Copyright and license are recorded centrally in REUSE.toml, which reuse lint checks, not in a header in each file. Gold only.
license_per_file_justification: Same: REUSE.toml records the license for each file, and there is no per-file header. Gold only.
small_tasks_justification: No labelled starter issues yet. Gold only.
require_2FA_justification: The monte3l organization requires two-factor authentication for every member.
secure_2FA_justification: The organization requires 2FA but does not require a phishing-resistant method. Gold only.
code_review_standards_justification: The ruleset requires a review, but the review standard is not written down beyond CONTRIBUTING.md. Gold only.
two_person_review_justification: Review by someone other than the author is required on every change now, but the share of recent changes has to build up first. https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/docs/GOVERNANCE.md#gold-level-criteria-this-project-does-not-meet. Gold only.
test_statement_coverage90_justification: Coverage measures about 90.1% lines but the gate is 80%, so 90% is not enforced. Gold only.
test_branch_coverage80_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/.github/workflows/verify.yml gates branch coverage at 80%. It measures about 86%.
hardened_site_justification: The docs site on Cloudflare has not been checked against the required security headers. Gold only.
hardening_justification: The software is a local script and a plugin skill, not a web application that serves headers.
security_review_justification: The assurance case is a self-review. No independent review has been done. Gold only.
crypto_used_network_justification: No cryptography and no network use.
crypto_tls12_justification: The plugin makes no network call.
osps_ac_04_01_justification: Every workflow sets a top-level permissions block (read-only or empty), and a job asks for more only where it needs it.
osps_br_02_01_justification: Each release has a unique semantic version in .claude-plugin/plugin.json and a unique tag m3l-output-governor--vX.Y.Z.
osps_br_04_01_justification: Each release's notes are the matching CHANGELOG.md section, generated from Conventional Commits, so fixes and security changes are named.
osps_br_05_01_justification: The only dependencies ingested are the CI tools, installed with npm ci from a committed lockfile.
osps_br_06_01_justification: Release tags are signed. From the release after 1.0.0 the source tarball carries a Sigstore attestation. https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/SECURITY.md#verifying-releases.
osps_do_07_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#building-and-testing -- there is nothing to build, and the Node version is named.
osps_gv_01_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/docs/GOVERNANCE.md#roles-and-members-with-access lists the two organization owners, the only people with access to sensitive resources.
osps_gv_03_02_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-requests and #coding-standards state what a contribution must meet.
osps_le_01_01_justification: Every commit needs a Signed-off-by trailer, and the DCO sign-off check in verify.yml fails a pull request without one.
osps_qa_03_01_justification: The main ruleset requires the verify check and the other required checks to pass before a merge, with an empty bypass list.
osps_qa_06_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/.github/workflows/verify.yml runs the unit tests, the harness tests and the docs gate on every pull request.
osps_vm_01_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/SECURITY.md#response-process gives the disclosure policy with its timeframes.
osps_vm_04_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/SECURITY.md#published-vulnerability-data -- confirmed vulnerabilities are published as GitHub security advisories.
osps_ac_04_02_justification: Each job asks only for the permissions it uses. Only the release jobs hold contents write, id-token and attestations, scorecard holds security-events and id-token, and the labeler holds pull-requests write. zizmor checks it.
osps_br_01_04_justification: Workflows pass event and input values to run steps through env, never by interpolating them into a script, and zizmor reports no template injection.
osps_br_02_02_justification: Release assets are named with the release version, and the Sigstore bundle sits beside the tarball it covers.
osps_br_07_02_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/SECURITY.md#secrets-and-credentials gives the policy for storing, accessing and rotating credentials.
osps_do_03_02_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/SECURITY.md#verifying-releases names the signer workflow the attestation must come from.
osps_do_05_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/SECURITY.md#scope-and-duration-of-support says a release stops getting security updates when the next one is published.
osps_gv_04_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/docs/GOVERNANCE.md#granting-access requires a track record and an identity check before access is widened.
osps_qa_02_02_justification: The released assets are a source tarball, not compiled software.
osps_qa_04_02_justification: The project is a single repository.
osps_qa_07_01_justification: The main ruleset requires a code-owner approval from someone other than the author, with an empty bypass list.
osps_vm_04_02_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependency-and-code-scanning-findings sets the VEX policy. There is no non-affecting finding to account for today.
osps_vm_05_02_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependency-and-code-scanning-findings -- no release is cut with an open critical or high finding.
osps_vm_05_03_justification: dependency-review.yml fails a pull request on a high-severity vulnerability or a license outside the allow list, and it is a required check.
osps_vm_06_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependency-and-code-scanning-findings gives the thresholds for static analysis findings.
osps_vm_06_02_justification: CodeQL runs on every push and pull request and is a required check, so a finding blocks the merge unless it is dismissed with a recorded reason.
